name: leadership
title: Leadership
description: A team list (who owns what), goals with their measures, and a decisions-needed list beside the standard project files.
audience: Plain language, outcome first: lead with status against goals, then risks, who owns what and the decisions needed; no code unless asked.

files.content:
# {TITLE} team

<!-- Who owns what, and who to go to for each area. Keep personal or HR notes out of the vault. -->

| Person | Owns | Backup |
|---|---|---|

# {TITLE} goals

<!-- This period's goals and how each will be measured. One line per goal: goal, measure, owner, status. -->

| Goal | Measure | Owner | Status |
|---|---|---|---|

# {TITLE} decisions needed

<!-- One line each: the decision, who decides, by when, what waits on it. -->

pane.label: Start my day
pane.prompt: Start my day: show what is waiting for me, what is overdue and what I should do first.

pane.label: Team status
pane.prompt: Summarise where each person or team stands on their work this week.

pane.label: Goals check
pane.prompt: Check progress on our goals against their measures.

pane.label: Decisions needed
pane.prompt: Show the decisions that are waiting on me.

pane.label: What is waiting
pane.prompt: What handoffs and tasks are waiting for me?

pane.label: Add a task
pane.prompt: I want to add a task. Ask me what it is and which project it belongs to.

pane.label: Note a decision
pane.prompt: Write down a decision. Ask me what was decided and why.

pane.label: Open a project
pane.prompt: Open a project for me. Ask me which one.

pane.label: Sort my inbox
pane.prompt: Review my inbox and file each item into the right project.

pane.label: Find in my notes
pane.prompt: Look something up in my notes. Ask me what I am looking for.

pane.label: Write a handoff
pane.prompt: Write a handoff for the next session so nothing is lost.
